page: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 44 physical cores and 88 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations.

This server is equipped with 3892.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 44.23 GB per core. For local storage, it includes an 8192 GB SSD and is Premium Storage capable. The absence of a GPU makes it reliant on CPU-based execution, but the massive memory footprint and local storage capacity support large-scale, data-intensive workloads.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in several areas. The server achieves top-tier status in large-block memory bandwidth for both read and write operations, as well as in Passmark database operations and static web serving throughput. Multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores fall into the strong category. Additionally, the hardware supports Intel AMX, which contributes to strong prompt processing speeds during LLM inference on medium and large models.

Given the high density of memory and local SSD storage, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive in-memory datasets rather than raw GPU acceleration. It is highly suited for large-scale relational and non-relational databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy compilation tasks.
